svg.title: Commercial LV cabling design: installation cutaway
svg.desc: Indicative isometric arrangement, not an as-built survey. A padmount kiosk feeds a main switchboard through a fifteen metre buried conduit run. A cutaway slab reveals three separate buried submains and risers to boards in the supermarket, hairdresser and butcher tenancies. Communal circuits are beside the MSB. A shaded working area and a local main earth electrode show installation relationships. An enlarged trench section shows backfill, marker tape, sand surround, bedding and the conduit grouping; layer thicknesses are indicative. Electrical ratings are in the one-line view.
